art_direction: 绯红短发女性交臂倚墙，一脚轻抵墙面，奶白夏衬衫和黑色短裤在电蓝与朱红硬边色块中格外鲜明。
composition_variation: One striking original 28-year-old adult anime woman with a sleek crimson angled bob, burgundy inner layers, luminous golden amber eyes, refined slightly angular face and a self-possessed amused smile with one brow gently raised. She leans shoulder and upper back against a vivid blue wall, arms loosely crossed at her upper waist. One knee bends with that sneaker lightly against the wall; the other leg supports her weight. Clean crossed forearms with plausible hands resting on opposite upper arms. A relaxed cool street-fashion pose with an angled torso. Outfit: opaque ivory short-sleeved camp-collar shirt with a normal secure neckline, charcoal tailored mid-thigh shorts, white sneakers with red trim. Frame from head to upper calves, slightly from the side at eye height so the bent knee and wall relationship read clearly. Minimalist cobalt concrete corner, vermilion pavement, one acid-yellow stripe low behind her. Split lighting uses electric blue shadows, coral sunlight and amber eye glints. Natural peach skin, no muddy shading. Upper quarter is brilliant cobalt with a thin vermilion far edge. Precise anime game-art polish, glossy hair and a crisp powerful silhouette.
